ui_bugs.issue: After a successful Nano Banana generation, the Generate button stays labelled 'Generating...' and disabled instead of resetting back to 'Generate visual'. The preview image itself renders correctly and the slide media_url is updated, but the loading state does not clear until a full re-fetch/navigation. Cosmetic — user can still work.

issues: Tooltip grammar: 'Longest streak: 1 days' — should be pluralised properly ('1 day' vs 'N days'). Very minor copy polish.

action_items: (LOW) In CourseEditPage VisualEditor, reset the isGenerating state (setIsGenerating(false)) inside the .finally() branch OR right after setting the preview URL so the button label reverts to 'Generate visual' when the request completes.
(NIT) Fix pluralisation in the sidebar-streak-pill tooltip (DashboardLayout.tsx line ~110) — use `${streak.longest_streak} day${streak.longest_streak === 1 ? '' : 's'}`.

(OPTIONAL) Consider surfacing budget_cents in the visual/video editor cards so admins see cost-per-generation before hitting Generate (Nano Banana ~4c, Sora-2 4s ~10c, Sora-2-pro 12s ~1.20$). Would help avoid accidental Sora job cost blow-outs.
critical_code_review_comments: authoring_media.py cleanly separates video (async job → JobQueue) from visuals (sync fetch → base64 → static file). Correct choice — Sora is 3-5 min blocking so it MUST be async; Nano Banana is ~10s so sync is fine.
video_service.py validates model/duration/size against explicit whitelists before any expensive call — clean 400 responses with the allowed set echoed in the detail. Good UX for API consumers.
visuals_service.py Pydantic schema pins min_length=8 on prompt — 422 comes for free from FastAPI validation instead of hand-written 400. Cleaner and self-documenting via /docs.

reorder_slides_early uses a two-pass negative-index trick to work around the uq_course_slides_order unique constraint — this is a known SQLite/Postgres pattern and correct. Alternative would be `DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED` but that's Postgres-only, so this approach is portable. Well-chosen.

attach_to_slide=true correctly updates both slide.media_url AND slide.slide_type=IMAGE inside a single transaction — verified by UI test (tab flipped from TEXT to IMAGE after generation). No race window.

DashboardLayout.tsx sidebar-streak-pill: polls every 60s via setInterval — good pace, won't hammer the streak endpoint. Conditional render `streak && streak.current_streak > 0` is exactly what the spec asks for. Fetch error is swallowed with .catch(() => {}) which is fine here (fail-quiet, hide pill).
Feature-flag drift now clean — every test_iteration22 assertion matches the current /authoring/status shape.
